## Example

```qml

    padding: Theme.paddingControlH
    Label { text: qsTr("Pane body") }
}
```

## API

Style-only control: no extra QWinUI3 properties. Use the Qt Quick Controls `Pane` API (this file only supplies Fluent visuals / metrics).
